refresh_conditions: Any source digest above changes at a newly selected revision: re-read the affected reference against the new bytes and update this record.
The integration owner selects a different specification, contract or template revision for this assignment.
A destination digest here stops matching the file in the package: that is drift, and the package copy is stale until reconciled.
The devforge-evaluate-expert runner interface is committed and differs from the schema recorded under runner_dependency: evals/cases.jsonl is reconciled against the committed interface.

The DevForge CLI gains a command that resolves an artifact reference or admits a product brief: the missing-integration statements in SKILL.md and references/recording-rules.md stop being accurate and must be re-derived from the new --help surface.
